final: WITH pg AS (SELECT p.ID AS pid, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT sex, AVG(avg_igm) AS A FROM pg GROUP BY sex), bb AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sx) SELECT sx.sex, sx.A, sx.A - bb.B AS diff FROM sx JOIN bb ON bb.B IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sx.sex
